Landing.headline: One paste,
Landing.headlineItalic: a full application — ready to send.
Landing.description: Drop in a job description and HireMe writes a tailored resume, the right cover letter, and an outreach email in a single pass — no rewriting, no template-juggling. Then it stays with you through assessment, interview prep, and follow-up, all the way to the offer.
Landing.feature01Body: Paste the posting. Get back a role-specific resume, a cover letter only when the company actually wants one, and an email with the right attachments listed — all grounded in your real experience, never invented.
Landing.feature02Body: Job details, generated documents, version history, status, notes, assessment, and interview prep — everything for that role lives in one place. No browser-tab archaeology.
Landing.feature03Body: Saved → Applied → Assessment → Interview → Offer. See where each role stands and where you're losing momentum, from a single dashboard.
Landing.feature04Title: All the way to the interview
Landing.feature04Body: When a callback comes, HireMe drafts the likely questions and a structured prep doc from the job description and your background — so you walk in ready, not cramming.
Landing.footerDisclaimer: Drafts are starting points — give them one read before you send.

Privacy.heading: Privacy at HireMe.
Privacy.intro: HireMe helps you turn job postings into polished applications. To do that, we hold on to a small amount of your information — your account, your resume, the postings you save, and the drafts we generate. This page explains exactly what we collect, how we use it, and how you can take it back.
Privacy.collectBody:
Account info: email and name you sign up with, plus a hashed password (handled by Supabase Auth).
Profile: target role, years of experience, target industries, dream companies — only what you choose to enter.
Resume: the file you upload and the parsed text we extract from it.
Applications: each job posting you save and the documents we generate for it (resume, cover letter, email, interview notes).
Usage: standard server logs (IP, request timing) for reliability and abuse prevention. We do not run third-party advertising or behavioural-tracking pixels.
Privacy.aiBody: When you ask HireMe to analyze a posting or generate a document, we send the relevant text — your resume, the job description, your prompt — to {provider} for inference. We send only what is needed for that request. The provider may temporarily process this content to return a response, subject to their own terms. We do not allow the provider to train models on your inputs. Our AI provider may change in the future; this page will be updated and the change announced before the new provider receives any of your data.
Privacy.storageBody: All account data, profiles, resumes, applications, and generated documents are stored in Supabase (Postgres database and object storage), hosted in a region we control. Files are accessible only to you, scoped by row-level security tied to your user ID.
Privacy.retentionBody: We keep your data for as long as your account is active. You can delete an individual application, resume, or generated document at any time from the app. To delete your account and everything tied to it, email us — we will erase the account and associated rows within 30 days.
Privacy.rightsBody: You can access, correct, export, or delete your data at any time. If you are in the EU, UK, or another jurisdiction with similar laws (GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA), you have the additional rights granted by those laws — including the right to object, the right to restrict processing, and the right to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority.
Privacy.cookiesBody: We use only the cookies required to keep you signed in and to remember your language preference. No third-party analytics or advertising cookies are set.
Privacy.contactBody: Privacy questions, deletion requests, or anything else — email   and we will get back to you.

You are responsible for reading every draft before you send it, and for the accuracy of anything you submit to an employer. We do not guarantee any particular outcome from your applications.
